key.name: focus-left
key.description: Move focus to the closest managed window on the left

key.name: focus-down
key.description: Move focus to the closest managed window below

key.name: focus-up
key.description: Move focus to the closest managed window above

key.name: focus-right
key.description: Move focus to the closest managed window on the right

key.name: tile-left
key.description: Tile the active window to the left half of the screen

key.name: tile-right
key.description: Tile the active window to the right half of the screen

key.name: maximize-window
key.description: Maximize the active window, or move it up the tiling stack

key.name: restore-window
key.description: Move the active window down the tiling stack, back to the mosaic

key.name: swap-left
key.description: Swap the active window with its left neighbor (mosaic or tiling)

key.name: swap-right
key.description: Swap the active window with its right neighbor (mosaic or tiling)

key.name: swap-up
key.description: Swap the active window with its upper neighbor (quarter tiles only)

key.name: swap-down
key.description: Swap the active window with its lower neighbor (quarter tiles only)
